slides.headline: GROK REPLACES A $5,000 PRODUCT SHOOT WITH A SINGLE TYPED SENTENCE
slides.kicker: 5 prompts, here's the exact ask each time
slides.image_prompt: the person in the reference photo waist-up, both hands thrusting a glowing smartphone toward camera — a flawless luxury product shot on screen, no readable text on screen. Triumphant sly grin, eyes locked to camera. A crumpled paper invoice stamped '$5K' prominent on the studio floor in the foreground. Behind him: an upscale photography studio, expensive camera rigs and studio strobes standing cold and unused. The glowing X logo exactly as in the reference image on the wall in warm white neon. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural skin texture, slight film grain. Accent: electric screen-white against cool gunmetal studio grey.

slides.headline: 1) SHOW GROK ANY IMAGE AND ASK HOW TO COPY IT
slides.body: Prompt courses for this sell for $200 to $500. Grok does it free in 10 seconds: "Give me the exact style, lighting, mood, and full prompt to recreate this image in Grok."

slides.headline: 2) MAKE PORTRAITS THAT LOOK LIKE MOVIE STILLS
slides.body: Photographers charge $300 to $600 per portrait like this. "Create a cinematic portrait of [describe the person]. Natural golden light through dusty window blinds. Film grain. Shot at 85mm. Denis Villeneuve's visual style."

slides.headline: 3) TURN A SENTENCE INTO AN $8,000 STUDIO SHOOT
slides.body: Product studios charge $3,000 to $8,000 per shoot day for this. "Create a luxury product shot of [your product]. White marble surface. Soft dramatic side lighting. Clean white background. Shot on Hasselblad, commercial style."

slides.headline: 4) BUILD AN EPIC FANTASY SCENE FROM ONE LINE
slides.body: Concept artists charge $150 to $400 per scene for this. "Create an epic fantasy scene: [describe what's happening]. Sweeping mountain landscape, dramatic storm clouds, shafts of golden light. Ultra-detailed painted realism. Wide low-angle shot."

slides.headline: 5) GENERATE NEON CITY SHOTS THAT STOP ANY SCROLL
slides.body: Getty Images sells shots like this for $50 to $200 each. "Create a neon-lit city street at night. Rain-soaked pavement reflecting pink and blue neon. Lone figure walking away. Dense fog. Blade Runner atmosphere."
